name: What is the typical remodeling project timeline?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical remodeling project timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodeling project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. Small projects, like a bathroom refresh, might take 3-6 weeks. Larger projects, such as a full kitchen remodel or an addition, can range from 3-6 months or longer. This includes design, permitting, material selection, and construction. We provide a detailed schedule after the initial planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodeling timelines depend on project scope, from a few weeks for small jobs to several months for larger ones.
